description: Create a subscription audit spreadsheet to track recurring charges and calculate potential savings. Open the spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/subscription_audit.xlsx. The sheet has headers but no data. Enter at least 6 subscriptions with: Service Name, Category, Billing Cycle (Monthly/Annual/Quarterly/Weekly), Charged Amount, and Usage Value (High/Medium/Low). Create formulas in the Monthly Cost column to normalize all charges to monthly equivalents (Annual÷12, Quarterly÷3, Weekly×4.33, Monthly as-is). Create formulas in the Annual Savings column to calculate monthly cost × 12. At the bottom, create a summary row that calculates total potential savings for only Low value items using SUMIF. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
